Name: Aviary OUTDATED
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[s]There are so many birds available to the game now that at this point that I thought they could use an aviary. So, I made one!

The aviary will cost you 50,000, 50 Iron Bars, 300 wood, and 100 stone. It will take Robin 3 days to build. It can house 50 animals (both coop and barn!) and features indoor ponds to make any waterfowl you may have happy!

Notes:
~The indoor ponds are COSMETIC ONLY until/unless I can figure out how to use terrain tiles on an indoor map As of 4.0, the ponds are semi-functional! But now all the animals can wind up in the water...hopefully I can fix that soon!
~Technically you can keep ANY animal in here, I just suggest birds for organization's sake lol
~Deluxe Coops and Barns need to be unlocked first to allow all the animals to use the aviary

Credit to ConcernedApe for the wonders of Stardew Valley, but especially for the greenhouse artwork that I recolored for this mod. Also I feel honorable mentions should go to ApryllForever whose mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23732]Quonset Barn[/url] inspired this idea, and Proudunicorn for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6618]Irrigation Mod[/url] which inspired the look of the water tiles.

I have plans to improve on this mod such as recolor and aesthetic compatibilities, and like I said I'm hoping to figure out how to make the water features real, so stay tuned! As of 4.0, the exterior has been redesigned and can come in Vanilla colors or a Warm recolor! Interior comes in Vanilla and grapeponta's Vibrant Pastoral recolor!

~Like my work? [url=https://ko-fi.com/victoriawilliams4870]Buy me a coffee![/url] ☕


[/s]This mod is currently scrapped and done with. Find my new and improved version here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43543
